objective: Correct the RC high-pass topology and Bode geometry, upgrade output QA to all-frame scanning, and expose a new E-drive Jianying draft through the actual Jianying projects root without copying media to C:.

root_cause.jianying_visibility: The v5 draft was written to E:/OpenClaw_VideoFactory_Runtime/jianying_drafts, while the desktop Jianying application enumerates C:/Users/Admin/AppData/Local/JianyingPro/User Data/Projects/com.lveditor.draft.
root_cause.topology_visual: A decorative sine path crossed the resistor body and was not electrically meaningful.
root_cause.bode_visual: The fc markers used hard-coded coordinates instead of the amplitude and phase curve functions.

constraints: All rendered media, timing probes, source files, and Jianying draft content remain on E:.
The C: Jianying projects root may receive only one new NTFS directory junction pointing to the E: draft; the target must not exist and no existing draft may be overwritten.
No source MP4, source audio, source frame, full transcript, watermark, or creator identity is reused.
Remotion remains the sole picture renderer; HyperFrames supplies layout/timing inspection principles; Jianying remains the only editor backend.
CapCut Mate and JianYing MCP remain disabled; automatic export, desktop UI automation, publication, Feishu, Cron, and PROJECT_STATUS promotion remain disabled.
Every output frame is mechanically scanned; six chapter/key transition frames receive visual review before draft creation.
acceptance: No waveform geometry intersects the resistor or ground geometry in the topology scene.
At fc, green amplitude and orange phase markers are computed from their own curves and land on -3 dB and +45 degree lanes respectively.
Full-frame report records all 3060 frames scanned, no black frame, and no unintended static run; visual inspection evidence covers the corrected topology and Bode hero frames.
A new E-drive Jianying v6 draft has 1 video, 1 unmuted voice-over, and 1 subtitle track, and a verified C: directory junction makes the draft discoverable by Jianying.
The audible preview contains AAC and the final report retains the manual Jianying listening/export gate.
rollback: Remove only the exact new junction after resolving and proving that it points to the generated E: draft; preserve old drafts, candidates, and all prior reports.
